ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Medicaid Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota and identify any patterns or connections between cases.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid fraud in Minnesota?
How are cases being investigated and prosecuted?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant wrongdoing and highlight the need for increased scrutiny of Medicaid claims and providers.
